statement.zh: 摩亨佐-达罗等整合期城市具有发达的井与排水系统；功能标签（大浴场/粮仓）仍属推测。
statement.en: Integration Era cities such as Mohenjo-daro have elaborate wells and drains; functional labels (Great Bath/granaries) remain speculative.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
